about_the_game:
Rare Rabbits – Snuggle Haven is an adorable, turn-based simulation game where you can already breed more than 6,000,000 unique rabbits and manage your very own rabbit farm. Each rabbit’s appearance and traits are determined by scientifically accurate genetics and inheritance principles, down to the smallest allele!
Take good care of your long-eared friends, play mini-games with them, and build dreamy hutches and homes for your rabbits.

Game Features:

  • Discover over 6 million rabbit variations

  • Breeding is based on real genetics, down to the allele level

  • Breed at your own pace – no stress, just pure discovery, round by round

  • Follow your curiosity – take on quests for inspiration or breed freely as you wish

  • Meet quirky customers – from a hedgehog wizard to the mysterious vixen Alice

  • Dance, race, and play with your rabbits in fun little mini-games

  • Sell your rarest rabbits to afford new upgrades and homes, or let your favorite bunnies stay with you forever in Snuggle Haven

Scientific Basis

While playing Rare Rabbits - Snuggle Haven, you’ll learn about the principles of genetics in a playful way (dominant-recessive inheritance, co-dominant traits, etc.).
To create specific fur colors and coat patterns, you’ll need to study the family trees and rare alleles of your rabbits carefully and choose the best breeding pairs accordingly.

Feeding, Upgrading and Building

Your rabbits need more than just love – they also need good food and a cozy home. With the money you earn from selling your rabbits, you can buy different houses, upgrade them, and even expand your meadow!
But be prepared… winter is coming – are you ready?

Relaxed Exploration

Discover ultra-rare alleles across eight rarity levels in your bred rabbits, and learn more about the real principles of inheritance through the in-game book.
With the “1 month = 1 game round” system, you decide how much time you want to spend with your rabbits each month.

Do you have what it takes to breed the rarest rabbits?
